window.rule: requested maximum horizon of 3 days from the observation time; games tipping off on or after 2026-11-18T11:29:57Z are outside the window

extraction_notes: The PDF text carries the column header "LOCAL | ET" (read 2026-11-15 from chunk 0 of the PDF text). The first time column (tip_et_col1) is the local tip time at the home venue and the second (tip_et_col2) is Eastern time. Checked for all 22 window rows: the Eastern value equals the home venue's local time converted to ET in 22 of 22 rows. This is a consistency check against venue time zones, not a statement taken from the document; both values stay verbatim.

The extracted PDF text prints no "at" token on rows 215-259 (11/10 to 11/18), while rows 260 onward print "at"; re-confirmed on the 2026-11-15 fetch (matches pass 6/7 finding, flag P7-02). Away/home order is therefore shown as "at" only where the 2026-11-15 06:15 AM injury report independently prints the same AWAY@HOME code; every other row shows printed order and is flagged.

Corroboration (checked 2026-11-15): the 06:15 AM injury report prints 17 matchup codes that match window rows 236-252 one-for-one - the 9 games of 11/15 (rows 236-244: IND@PHI, LAL@PHX, CHA@LAC, SAS@UTA, DAL@BOS, NYK@TOR, HOU@WAS, ATL@MIL, OKC@SAC) and the 8 NOT YET SUBMITTED games of 11/16 (rows 245-252: ORL@BOS, CHI@CLE, MEM@WAS, PHI@BKN, HOU@MIA, POR@MIN, GSW@NOP, PHX@DEN). The report's Game Time values equal the schedule's ET column on all 17 rows. Rows 253-257 (11/17) have no independent code yet: they show printed order only and are flagged unverified.
Out-of-window follow-on rows 258-269 (11/18) were read but are excluded: the earliest 11/18 tip (rows 258-259, 7:00 PM ET = 2026-11-19T00:00Z) falls after the window end of 2026-11-18T11:29:57Z.
No venue, broadcast-independent status, odds, probability or pick is present in this file or taken from the PDF.
